capabilities: Lay out Hebrew clauses with conjunction, predicate pattern, discourse function and English columns
Tag clauses as mainline or offline narrative or speech (Hx/Dx) with level badges and indentation
Map a story's plot as a flow chart of labelled blocks and arrows on the Story tab
Import older Excel DA Template workbooks (.xlsm) and save analyses as .hda files
Export the current tab as a PNG
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manual download. Also runs as a standalone browser app that keeps one analysis locally. Works offline and makes no network requests; all settings (themes, Hebrew fonts, indent) are configurable.
intentEvidence: Excel import: converts the older 4-column and the newer 9-column "DA Template" workbooks (.xlsm).
problem: Obsidian has no tool for clause-level text-linguistic analysis of Hebrew prose, which is otherwise done in spreadsheet templates like the Excel DA Template.

relations.evidence: Excel import: converts the older 4-column and the newer 9-column "DA Template" workbooks (.xlsm).
